preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.
A victim address must hold a non-zero balance of the token and not be on the blacklist.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `setBlacklist(address account, bool value)` function. Set the `account` parameter to the victim's address and the `value` parameter to `true`. This action will add the victim to the blacklist, preventing them from transferring any tokens and effectively freezing their assets.
